request.style: English, male gritty rock voice, electric guitar, bass, drums, organ, heavy mood, 95 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
From the camp on the north side
Ahira son of Enan stands
The banner of Dan is near
Where the tribe of Naphtali lands
Fifty-three thousand men
Listed by name and clan
Fit for battle they stand
Under the starry canopy

[Chorus]
On the twelfth day he comes
With the offering of the last prince
Silver plates and gold dish
In the tabernacle of God
This was the offering
Of Ahira son of Enan

[Verse]
When the wilderness broke camp
The rear guard moves along
Ahira leads the division
Where the north wind blows strong
Two oxen and five rams
Five male lambs a year old
Sin offering and burnt offering
Laid upon the holy ground

[Chorus]
On the twelfth day he comes
With the offering of the last prince
Silver plates and gold dish
In the tabernacle of God
This was the offering
Of Ahira son of Enan

[Outro]
Son of Enan he was
Chief of Naphtali's band
Faithful in his charge
Until the journey ends
